title: Power savings for planar halving lines and k-sets

result.label: Power savings for planar halving lines and k-sets
result.statement: Improves the planar halving-line bound to O(n^ 4/3- ) for sets with no three collinear and an absolute ε > 0. More generally, an n -point set with no three collinear has O(n(k+1)^ 1/3- 0 ) strictly separable k -subsets for 1 k n/2, with an absolute 0 0. The constants and positive exponents are nonquantitative.
